API 只能移进回收站，不能彻底删除: The API can only move a page to the trash, not delete it permanently
Notion 原样的属性 JSON；归一化会丢信息的类型（rollup/form: The raw Notion properties JSON; use this for types where normalization would lose information (rollup/formula)
Notion 回的当前全文: The current full text Notion returned
Notion 的块对象数组，原样透传。普通正文用「改页面正文」更省事，这里是给: An array of Notion block objects, passed through as-is. For ordinary body text, “Edit page content” is simpler — this is for blocks markdown can't express (embeds, boards, database blocks)
Notion 的块对象数组，形状由块类型决定（25 种，且随版本增补），原样透传: An array of Notion block objects; the shape depends on the block type (25 kinds, with more added over time), passed through as-is
Notion 的排序数组，原样透传。例：[{\"property\":\"更新时: Notion's sort array, passed through as-is. Example: [{"property":"Updated","direction":"descending"}]
Notion 的过滤 DSL，原样透传。例：{\"property\":\"状态: Notion's filter DSL, passed through as-is. Example: {"property":"Status","status":{"equals":"In Progress"}}
edit 用；必须与页面里的文字一字不差: Used for edit; must match the text on the page exactly
edit 用；留空 = 删掉这段: Used for edit; empty = delete this text
edit 用；默认只替换第一处: Used for edit; by default only the first occurrence is replaced
emoji 或图片链接: An emoji or an image URL
false = Notion 算出来的（formula/rollup/creat: false = computed by Notion (formula/rollup/created_time…); writes are rejected
notion.so/profile/integrations 建一个「内部」集成: Create an “internal” integration at notion.so/profile/integrations and copy the string starting with ntn_ from the “Secrets” tab; leave empty if using OAuth instead. **After filling this in, you still need to go to each Notion page and connect it to this integration via “⋯ → Connections”** — otherwise nothing can be read
select / status / multi_select 才有: Only present for select / status / multi_select
true = 页面太大，markdown 只是一部分: true = the page is too large; the markdown is only a partial excerpt
与讨论串 id 二选一: Give either this or the discussion thread ID, not both
事件源自动维护，勿手填: Maintained automatically by the event source; do not fill in by hand
仅 person，且集成有权限时才有: Only present for a person, and only if the integration has permission
作为数据源的一行: As a row in a data source
例：{\"名称\":{\"title\":{}},\"状态\":{\"selec: Example: {"Name":{"title":{}},"Status":{"select":{"options":[{"name":"To do"},{"name":"Done"}]}}}; there must be **exactly one** title column, or Notion rejects the request
写「负责人」这类 people 属性要用这里的 id: Use the ID here when writing a "people" property such as "Owner"
写入属性时用的键: The key to use when writing this property
勾选 = 从回收站拿回来: Check to restore from the trash
勾选后多一次请求，取整页 markdown: When checked, makes one extra request to fetch the full page markdown
勿手填: Do not fill in by hand
单源库只有一个；查询与建行用它的 id: A single-source database has only one; use its ID for querying and creating rows
单源库直接接这个往下走: For a single-source database, use this directly for the next step
只匹配标题，不搜正文；留空 = 列出集成能看到的全部: Matches titles only, not body text; empty = lists everything the integration can see
只给要改的列。加列 {\"新列\":{\"number\":{}}}；删列 {\: Give only the columns to change. Add a column with {"New column":{"number":{}}}; delete one with {"Old column":null}; rename one with {"Old column":{"name":"New name"}}
只给要改的列；没提到的列不动。清空某列用 null: Give only the columns to change; columns not mentioned are left alone. Use null to clear a column
回同一串评论时带上它: Include this when replying in the same comment thread
回某一串评论；来自「列评论」: Reply to a comment thread; from “List comments”
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 Notion: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required when the deployment environment can't reach Notion directly
属性名与类型由所在数据源的表结构决定；值已归一化: Property names and types are determined by the data source's schema; values are normalized
属性名与类型由该数据源的表结构决定，运行时才知道；值已归一化（文本→字符串、多选: Property names and types are determined by this data source's schema, known only at runtime; values are normalized (text→string, multi-select→string array, date→{start,end})
属性名与类型由该数据源的表结构决定；值已归一化: Property names and types are determined by this data source's schema; values are normalized
归一化写法：{\"状态\":\"进行中\",\"标签\":[\"A\",\"B\: Normalized form: {"Status":"In Progress","Tags":["A","B"],"Due":"2026-08-20"}; ignored when the parent is a page
往里建行用这个: Use this to create rows in it
数据库必须挂在某一页下: A database must be under a page
数据源行的标题会写进它的标题列（不必再在 props 里给一遍）: A data source row's title is written into its title column (no need to repeat it in props)
每行的属性已归一化到 props: Each row's properties are normalized into props
点「授权」后自动写入，勿手填: Filled in automatically after clicking “Authorize”; do not fill in by hand
父页面 id 或数据源 id；贴链接也行: A parent page ID or data source ID; pasting a link also works
用「列出数据源」从数据库 id 取；贴数据库链接时会当作单源库自动取第一个数据源: Get this from the database ID using “List data sources”; pasting a database link treats it as a single-source database and auto-selects its first data source
用法：追加块 {\"type\":\"file\",\"file\":{\"ty: Usage: append a block {"type":"file","file":{"type":"file_upload","file_upload":{"id":"<this id>"}}}, or write it into a files property
留空 = 用文件自带的名字: Empty = uses the file's own name
留空 = 读本集成自己的机器人身份: Empty = reads this integration's own bot identity
要正文用「读页面」，要行用「查询数据源」: For content, use “Read page”; for rows, use “Query data source”
读一次 Notion 的 /users/me，报令牌是否有效以及它代表哪个集成。: Calls Notion's /users/me once and reports whether the token is valid and which integration it belongs to. A valid token doesn't guarantee access to any given page — the page must also be connected to this integration in Notion via “⋯ → Connections”
读写 Notion：搜索、查表、建页、改正文（markdown）、评论、文件，并: Reads and writes Notion: search, query tables, create pages, edit content (markdown), comments, files, and can act as an event source —
贴完整 Notion 链接也行: Pasting a full Notion link also works
贴完整 Notion 链接也行，会自己抠出 id: Pasting a full Notion link also works; the ID is extracted automatically
这一行属于哪张表: Which table this row belongs to
逗号分隔的数据源 id 或链接（数据库链接直接贴即可）；留空 = 不产事件。改完: Comma-separated data source IDs or links (a database link can be pasted directly); empty = no events are produced. Takes effect as soon as saved — the event source restarts automatically
页面本身就是块，贴页面 id 即读整页顶层块: A page is itself a block; paste a page ID to read all of its top-level blocks
默认 100，上限 500；不递归子块: Default 100, max 500; does not recurse into child blocks
默认 60；Notion 限流 3 次/秒，盯的表越多别调得越短: Default 60; Notion rate-limits at 3 requests/second — the more tables you watch, the less you should shorten this
